node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock for copper, nickel HPAL, and fertilizers
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid feedstock node with emphasis on underfollowed second-order assets rather than obvious copper, nickel, or fertilizer leaders. The strongest underfollowed direct match found is Martin Midstream Partners, which has sulphur logistics, molten sulphur handling, sulphuric-acid production, sulphur fertilizers, and acid transportation exposure, but it is below the preferred USD 300M threshold and must be treated as a speculative exception. Hawkins is a cleaner USD 1B+ underfollowed distributor/terminal candidate with sulphuric acid in its industrial chemicals portfolio. Taseko is not an acid supplier, but its Florence SX/EW copper operation makes it an acid-dependent copper producer where fixed-price acid coverage and procurement terms become the key hidden variable. Southern Copper is included only as a reference anchor because it produces sulphuric acid and operates copper assets, but its mega-cap status makes it outside the main discovery lane.
